description: On the table there’s a gray tray holding several clear ice cubes, a small yellow cup to the left, and a purple scoop to the right. The left hand steadies the tray near its front edge while the right hand picks up the purple scoop, dips it into the tray to gather ice, then lifts and tilts the scoop over the yellow cup as the left hand brings the cup under it; the ice slides off the scoop into the cup and the right hand pulls the scoop away.
